assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis code for supraventricular tachycardia is I47.1.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is I25.10.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
The payer letter states that the decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal.
